findings.title: Journal-oracle call-site miswired: post-run zero-download assertion is vacuous
findings.detail: tests/test_zr805_t3_authorization.py:142 passes project/'.source_catalog'/'catalog.sqlite3' (a FILE) into _journal_downloaded_new, which expects a DIRECTORY and appends 'acquisition_attempts.jsonl'; the call therefore always returns constant 0 and the assert only compares 0==before (seed state), never the post-run journal. Tamper probe (outside both repos): appending a fake {"outcome":"downloaded_new"} line to a COPY of the journal -> oracle with correct dir counts 1 (function genuinely reads the file), oracle with the exact as-wired argument returns 0 (blind). Production truth independently verified correct: unauthorized missing-source run (rc=3, stdout empty, stderr JSON error contains not_found) leaves acquisition_attempts.jsonl ABSENT -> zero downloaded_new. One-line follow-up fix: drop /"catalog.sqlite3" at line 142. Does not block: behavior pinned by rc/stdout/not_found assertions plus this review's independent oracle parse.

findings.title: Machine-state/cursor drift: ZR-805 artifacts exist while state.json/README/locks remain at ZR-804
findings.detail: Committed (HEAD 3fc5f3e) and working-tree state.json both show current_next=ZR-804, active_owner=zr804-implementer (lease acquired 2026-08-22T18:48Z), no ZR-804 or ZR-805 unit entries; locks/ contains ZR-804.lock.json but NO ZR-805 lock; audit_review/README.md line 13 says current_next: ZR-804. The ZR-805 WU card claims 'current_next=ZR-805（ZR-804 closure 后推进）；锁 owner=zr805-implementer' and the implementer receipt scope lists state.json+locks as touched, but no machine-state evidence of a ZR-805 lease/cursor exists anywhere. Governance/bookkeeping issue only; the reviewed commit itself touches exactly one new test file and is unaffected.

findings.title: Positional failures from nested clean checkout (classified positional)
findings.detail: From .review-zr805-clean, test_t3_suite_is_opt_in_and_covers_three_markets fails ('filing-fetch T3 suite missing') and test_unauthorized_missing_source_zero_downloads_in_journal fails at the stderr assertion because PROJECT_ROOT.parent/'filing-fetch' resolves to revenue-forecast/filing-fetch which does not exist (real sibling is Projects/filing-fetch). Re-run of the single file from MAIN repo dir: 3 passed. Purely positional.

findings.title: Layered approach satisfies registry row; no unmet demand for an actual network download
findings.detail: Registry row's explicit '网络缺失 blocked' clause matches the implemented design: real T3 first-download+second-zero-download execution is solely owned by filing-fetch tests/test_e2e_download.py behind skipUnless(FILING_FETCH_E2E_DOWNLOAD=='1') plus tool-presence gate, running real providers against a temporary wiki with staging/lock residue checks; without authorization/network it skips (blocked), never fake-passes. Nothing in the card text requires THIS unit to perform a real download: AC① is structural (verified against filing-fetch HEAD today), AC② is hermetic (independently reproduced), AC③ is static surface. Card's claim holds.

objective: Independent acceptance review of ZR-805 (CN/HK/US T3 first-download + second zero-download under strict authorization): re-verify test-only commit 3fc5f3e (diff isolation, suite runs, independent journal-oracle probe incl. tamper test, filing-fetch T3 ownership/gate/marker presence at HEAD, entry-surface single-downloader routing, hardcoding scan, receipt/triplet integrity) and judge the layered approach against the registry row's explicit blocked/opt-in clause.
